019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.ArrayTestImpl;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.KindAssemblyTestImpl;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.KindDocumentTestImpl;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.KindFieldTestImpl;

030/**
031 * Provides type information that be used to discover type information for,
032 * test, and cast various item objects.
033 * <p>
034 * A variety of static methods are provided that can be used to generate tests
035 * that compare an item's actual type against an expectation.
036 */
037public interface IItemType {
038  /**
039   * Get a new kind test that matches any item.
040   *
041   * @return the test
042   */
043  @NonNull
044  static IItemType item() {
045    return AnyItemType.instance();
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Get a new kind test that matches any function item.
050   *
051   * @return the function test
052   */
053  @NonNull
054  static IItemType function() {
055    return AnyFunctionItemType.ANY_FUNCTION;
056  }
057
058  // static IFunctionTest function(@NonNull ISequenceType result, @NonNull
059  // ISequenceType... args) {
060  //
061  // }
062
063  /**
064   * Get a new kind test that matches any map item.
065   *
066   * @return the map test
067   */
068  @NonNull
069  static IItemType map() {
070    return AnyFunctionItemType.ANY_MAP;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Get a new kind test that matches any map item whose keys and values match the
075   * provided atomic type and sequence type respectively.
076   *
077   * @param key
078   *          the expected atomic type of the map's key
079   * @param value
080   *          the sequence test to use to check the map's contents
081   *
082   * @return the map test
083   */
084  @NonNull
085  static IMapTest map(@NonNull IAtomicOrUnionType<?> key, @NonNull ISequenceType value) {
086    return new MapTestImpl(key, value);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Get a new kind test that matches any array item whose values match the
091   * provided sequence.
092   *
093   * @return the array test
094   */
095  @NonNull
096  static IItemType array() {
097    return AnyFunctionItemType.ANY_ARRAY;
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Get a new kind test that matches any array item whose values match the
102   * provided sequence.
103   *
104   * @param value
105   *          the sequence test to use to check the array's contents
106   *
107   * @return the array test
108   */
109  @NonNull
110  static IItemType array(@NonNull ISequenceType value) {
111    return new ArrayTestImpl(value);
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Get a new kind test that matches any atomic valued item.
116   *
117   * @return the atomic type test
118   */
119  @NonNull
120  static IAtomicOrUnionType<?> anyAtomic() {
121    return TypeConstants.ANY_ATOMIC_TYPE;
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Get a new kind test that matches any {@link INodeItem}.
126   *
127   * @return the node kind test
128   */
129  @NonNull
130  static IKindTest<INodeItem> node() {
131    return AnyKindTest.ANY_NODE;
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Get a new kind test that matches any Metaschema {@link IModuleNodeItem}.
136   *
137   * @return the module kind test
138   */
139  @NonNull
140  static IKindTest<IModuleNodeItem> module() {
141    return AnyKindTest.ANY_MODULE;
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Get a new kind test that matches any {@link IDocumentNodeItem}.
146   *
147   * @return the document kind test
148   */
149  @NonNull
150  static IKindTest<IDocumentNodeItem> document() {
151    return AnyKindTest.ANY_DOCUMENT;
152  }
153
154  /**
155   * Get a new kind test that that matches an {@link IDocumentNodeItem} that has a
156   * root node of the provided kind.
157   *
158   * @param test
159   *          the root node test
160   * @return the document kind test
161   */
162  @NonNull
163  static IKindTest<IDocumentNodeItem> document(@NonNull IKindTest<IAssemblyNodeItem> test) {
164    return new KindDocumentTestImpl(test);
165  }
166
167  /**
168   * Matches any {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} regardless of its name or type.
169   *
170   * @return the test
171   */
172  @NonNull
173  static IKindTest<IAssemblyNodeItem> assembly() {
174    return AnyKindTest.ANY_ASSEMBLY;
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Get a new kind test that matches a {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} with the
179   * provided name and a type matching the provided name of a specific assembly
180   * definition.
181   * <p>
182   * If used as part of a document kind test, the the provided
183   * {@code instanceName} will match the root assembly name of the document's
184   * root.
185   *
186   * @param instanceName
187   *          the name of the assembly root definition or instance to match
188   *          depending on the use context
189   * @param typeName
190   *          the name of the assembly definition to match
191   * @param staticContext
192   *          the static context in which the test was declared
193   * @return the test
194   */
195  @NonNull
196  static IKindTest<IAssemblyNodeItem> assembly(
197      @NonNull IEnhancedQName instanceName,
198      @Nullable String typeName,
199      @NonNull StaticContext staticContext) {
200    return new KindAssemblyTestImpl(instanceName, typeName, staticContext);
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Get a new kind test that matches an {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} with any name
205   * and a type matching the provided name of a specific assembly definition.
206   *
207   * @param typeName
208   *          the name of the assembly definition to match
209   * @param staticContext
210   *          the static context in which the test was declared
211   * @return the test
212   */
213  @NonNull
214  static IKindTest<IAssemblyNodeItem> assembly(
215      @NonNull String typeName,
216      @NonNull StaticContext staticContext) {
217    return new KindAssemblyTestImpl(null, typeName, staticContext);
218  }
219
220  /**
221   * Matches any {@link IFieldNodeItem} regardless of its name or type.
222   *
223   * @return the test
224   */
225  @NonNull
226  static IKindTest<IFieldNodeItem> field() {
227    return AnyKindTest.ANY_FIELD;
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Matches any {@link IFieldNodeItem} with the provided name and a type matching
232   * the provided name of a specific field definition.
233   *
234   * @param instanceName
235   *          the name of the field instance to match depending on the use context
236   * @param typeName
237   *          the name of the field definition to match
238   * @param staticContext
239   *          the static context in which the test was declared
240   * @return the test
241   */
242  @NonNull
243  static IKindTest<IFieldNodeItem> field(
244      @NonNull IEnhancedQName instanceName,
245      @Nullable String typeName,
246      @NonNull StaticContext staticContext) {
247    return new KindFieldTestImpl(instanceName, typeName, staticContext);
248  }
249
250  /**
251   * Matches any {@link IFieldNodeItem} with a name and type matching the provided
252   * name of a specific field definition.
253   *
254   * @param typeName
255   *          the name of the field definition to match
256   * @param staticContext
257   *          the static context in which the test was declared
258   * @return the test
259   */
260  @NonNull
261  static IKindTest<IFieldNodeItem> field(@NonNull String typeName, @NonNull StaticContext staticContext) {
262    return new KindFieldTestImpl(null, typeName, staticContext);
263  }
264
265  /**
266   * Matches any {@link IFlagNodeItem} regardless of its name or type.
267   *
268   * @return the test
269   */
270  @NonNull
271  static IKindTest<IFlagNodeItem> flag() {
272    return AnyKindTest.ANY_FLAG;
273  }
274
275  /**
276   * Matches any {@link IFlagNodeItem} with the provided name and type matching
277   * the provided name of a specific globally-scoped flag definition.
278   *
279   * @param instanceName
280   *          the name of the flag instance to match
281   * @param typeName
282   *          the name of the flag definition or value type to match
283   * @param staticContext
284   *          the static context in which the test was declared
285   * @return the test
286   */
287  @NonNull
288  static IKindTest<IFlagNodeItem> flag(
289      @NonNull IEnhancedQName instanceName,
290      @Nullable String typeName,
291      @NonNull StaticContext staticContext) {
292    return new KindFlagTestImpl(instanceName, typeName, staticContext);
293  }
294
295  /**
296   * Matches any {@link IFlagNodeItem} with any name and type matching the
297   * provided name of a specific globally-scoped flag definition.
298   *
299   * @param typeName
300   *          the name of the globally-scoped flag definition to match
301   * @param staticContext
302   *          the static context in which the test was declared
303   * @return the test
304   */
305  @NonNull
306  static IKindTest<IFlagNodeItem> flag(@NonNull String typeName, @NonNull StaticContext staticContext) {
307    return new KindFlagTestImpl(null, typeName, staticContext);
308  }
309
310  /**
311   * Test if the provided item matches this item type.
312   *
313   * @param item
314   *          the item to test
315   * @return {@code true} if the item matches the expectations or {@code false}
316   *         otherwise
317   */
318  default boolean isInstance(IItem item) {
319    return getItemClass().isInstance(item);
320  }
321
322  /**
323   * Test if the provided item matches this item type.
324   *
325   * @param <T>
326   *          the Java type of the item tested
327   * @param item
328   *          the item to test
329   * @return the item if the test passes
330   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
331   *           if the test fails because the item is not the required type
332   */
333  @NonNull
334  default <T extends IItem> T test(@Nullable T item) {
335    if (item != null && isInstance(item)) {
336      return item;
337    }
338    throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
339        null,
340        String.format("The item '%s' is not a '%s'",
341            item == null ? "null" : item.toSignature(),
342            toSignature()));
343  }
344
345  /**
346   * Get the item Java class associated with this item type.
347   *
348   * @return the item Java class
349   */
350  @NonNull
351  Class<? extends IItem> getItemClass();
352
353  /**
354   * Get the human-readable signature of the item type.
355   *
356   * @return the signature
357   */
358  @NonNull
359  String toSignature();
360}
